verdict.rationale: Supermemory documents official TypeScript and Python clients that wrap its API (npm install supermemory, pip install supermemory). Its docs show SDK usage such as client.add and client.search with containerTag scoping, and it ships an official skill so agents use the real endpoints and auth. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and detailed SDK reference coverage beyond the code snippets (no OpenAPI spec was found by the probe).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Official clients wrap this API: TypeScript: npm install supermemory Python: pip install supermemory
await client.add({ content: "The user loves Paris.", containerTag: "user_123" });
const results = await client.search({ q: "where does Alex work?", containerTag: "user_123", include: { relatedMemories: true }, });
